title: The Legend of Zelda: Link’s Awakening
summary: The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening is the 2019 remake of the Game Boy classic, and it is one of the games that improves the most on Switch 2 through Nintendo's free update. On Switch 1 it ran at 720p docked with an unstable 60 FPS; on Switch 2, Digital Foundry measured 1620p on the TV and 1080p handheld with a locked 60 FPS. You do not need to buy anything for this: the update is free, and the original Switch 1 cartridge with the full game works in a Switch 2. At 5.9 GB it is a light install, so it is easy to keep on the console for a replay. Spanish is one of its 14 supported languages.
